messages:
ashley: Heads-up — planning a 60-min 'Runbook & Benchmarks' office hours for APAC-friendly time (Tue Apr 27 2pm JST / 10pm PT). Need reg page, Zoom config (cloud recording + SRT fallback), post-event lead routing to SFDC, and 1-min clip pulls for social. Who can own what?

sam: I can take the registration page + confirmation email. Need hero image, speaker bios, GA/UTM params, and an A/B test for the confirmation CTA (Join live vs Request recording).

jordan: Recommend Zoom Webinar (registration + capacity). Enable cloud recording (active speaker + shared screen). We'll route cloud recordings -> S3 via zapier->gcf. For low-latency fallback we can stream RTMP/SRT to a staging VM. If we want raw SRT files, I'll coordinate the recorder.

mike: I'll own the zapier -> GCF -> S3 pipeline. Plan: Zapier listens to Zoom registrant/recording finished -> post to our GCF -> persist to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/apac-2026/. Also add lead tag 'webinar_apac_2026' when sending to SFDC.

emily: I'll handle clip pulls + captions. Once recording lands in S3 I run an ffmpeg cutlist to export 1-min social clips and run through captions svc. Please add timestamp suggestions to this sheet: https://tinyurl.com/apac-clip-times

sam: @emily noted. Quick question: for the A/B confirm email, do we want Variant A 'Join live' immediate CTA, Variant B 'Add to calendar + recording later'? Which metric are we optimizing — live attendance or downstream conversion?

ashley: Let's prioritize live attendance but still measure downstream conversion. Run 60/40 split favoring live. Also add line in both variants: 'Recording available within 24 hours' to reduce dropouts.

jordan: Webhook payload example for Mike's GCF (so Zapier can pass registrant + utm):
```
{
  "email": "{{attendee_email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "utm_source": "{{utm_source}}",
  "session": "apac_office_hours_apr27"
}
```

mike: Perfect. I'll deploy the endpoint and post it here with auth details. ETA EOD tomorrow.

marketing-bot: Reminder: add caption vendor + SLA to the runbook. Options: Vimeo auto-captions (fast) or 3Play (accuracy target 95%). Also include data retention TTL for recordings.

ashley: Owners summary — Sam = reg page + emails, Jordan = Zoom + recording config, Mike = zapier/GCF pipeline + SFDC tagging, Emily = clip pulls + captions. I'll draft the runbook (timeline + checklist) and circulate for approvals. :thumbsup:
